intro: A 6-stage route to the platinum. Story stages follow the official chapters; stage 5 sweeps up side content; stage 6 is the 100% cleanup. Missable trophies are flagged next to the stage where their window closes.

stages.title: Prologue & Chapter 1
stages.focus: Just play the opening and the full first chapter; the story trophies arrive on their own.
stages.missable_notes: Just Like Paradise (Gone Fishing) and Paradise Lost (Chapter 1) are chapter-locked: they only pop while you play the prologue and Chapter 1. Neither can be earned later, so clear Chapter 1 before moving on.

stages.title: Chapter 2
stages.focus: Complete every Chapter 2 story mission; the two trophies unlock through the chapter.
stages.missable_notes: T**s Ass Drug Money (Chapter 2) and Trust (Breakfast Run) unlock only during Chapter 2. Play the chapter's missions to completion before Chapter 3 starts.

stages.title: Chapter 3
stages.focus: Finish the Chapter 3 story missions to collect the five chapter trophies.
stages.missable_notes: All six Chapter 3 trophies are chapter-locked, one per featured mission. They pop only as you complete Chapter 3, so do the whole chapter before Chapter 4.

stages.title: Chapter 4 & Final Mission
stages.focus: Complete Chapter 4 and then the final story mission to finish the campaign trophies.
trophies: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
stages.missable_notes: Top Of The World, Ma (Chapter 4) and You Gotta Know When to Get Off (final mission) only unlock during those beats. There is no post-game replay of the epilogue, so clear both before the credits.

stages.title: Side Content - Strangers, Activities & Collectibles
stages.focus: Knock out strangers & freaks strands, activities, challenges and collectibles. Do the choice- and heat-sensitive trophies here while the world is open.
stages.missable_notes: Retail Therapy, Catch Me If You Can and Actions Speak Louder are missable here: they depend on a live, un-busted wanted state or a story choice that does not repeat. Do them while side content is fully open.

stages.title: Cleanup & 100% Completion
stages.focus: Mop up anything left, then complete the campaign to 100% to close the gold, then the platinum.
stages.missable_notes: Nothing is missable at this stage; A Long Road (100%) and the platinum simply require everything else to be done.
